wiki.title: Brianna Titone
wiki.extract: Brianna Titone () is an American politician and scientist, currently serving as a member of the Colorado House of Representatives from the 27th district. Titone currently serves in the 75th Colorado General Assembly and is the first openly transgender state legislator elected in Colorado and the 4th elected in the United States. After the 2026 General Assembly, she will complete her limit of 4 terms having served 8 years.
